snippet.title: Cosminers - Pre-Alpha Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST HERE ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690100/Cosminers/

The official pre-alpha teaser for Cosminers - a sci-fi mining game where you play solo or team up with friends (either way, it’s going to get messy) to dig tunnels, fight loads of alien creatures, and build your way to survival on a distant Tau Ceti F.

Explore shifting undergrounds, survive the harsh day-night cycle, and upgrade your gear one drill at a time.

This is just the beginning.
